license_required.quote: No entity or individual may practice as a contractor by performing or offering to perform contracting work for which the total cost of construction is greater than ten thousand dollars for general contracting or greater than ten thousand dollars for mechanical contracting without a license issued in accordance with this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: There is created the South Carolina Contractor's Licensing Board under the administration of the Department of Labor, Licensing and Regulation.

name.quote: There is created the South Carolina Contractor's Licensing Board under the administration of the Department of Labor, Licensing and Regulation.

type.quote: The board consists of nine members appointed by the Governor, seven of whom must be licensed contractors. Of the seven contractors, one must have as the larger part of his business the construction of highways, one must have as the larger part of his business the construction of public utilities, one must have as the larger part of his business the construction of commercial, industrial, and institutional buildings, one must have as the larger part of his business the performance of heating, plumbing, or air conditioning work, one must have as the larger part of his business the performance of electrical work

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Labor, Licensing and Regulation
umbrella_agency.quote: There is created the South Carolina Contractor's Licensing Board under the administration of the Department of Labor, Licensing and Regulation.

required.quote: submit proof of having attained a grade of seventy percent or better on a technical examination where required for each classification or subclassification of licensure applied for

experience_source.quote: submit proof of having attained a grade of seventy percent or better on a technical examination where required for each classification or subclassification of licensure applied for

exams.name: Technical examination (Electrical subclassification)
exams.notes: Required for certification as a qualifying party in the electrical subclassification; must attain 70% or better.
exams.quote: submit proof of having attained a grade of seventy percent or better on a technical examination where required for each classification or subclassification of licensure applied for

exams.name: South Carolina law examination (Code of Laws)
exams.notes: Examination of South Carolina law regulating general and mechanical contracting; must attain 70% or better. An individual may retake exam two times in a 12-month period, then once every 6 months.
exams.quote: attain a grade of seventy percent or better on an examination of South Carolina law regulating general and mechanical contracting

interval_years.quote: All licenses may be renewed biennially.

available.quote: The board may grant a license or certificate to an applicant holding a license or certificate in good standing in another state whose requirements for licensure and certification are equal to or greater than those required by this chapter if the board has authorized an exam waiver agreement with the State.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a license in good standing in another state with equal or greater requirements; exam may be waived if board has authorized a waiver agreement, or if applicant can verify passing an equivalent exam in another state. South Carolina Commercial Contractors Business, Law and Project Management examination may be required. All other licensing and certification requirements must be met.
requirements.quote: An applicant may exempt the technical examination required for certification if the applicant can verify passing an examination in another state which is essentially the same as the examination required by the department regardless of the absence of a reciprocal agreement with that state.

bonding_required.quote: In lieu of providing a financial statement showing a minimum net worth or working capital for a license group as required by Section 40-11-260, an applicant may provide a surety bond from a surety authorized to transact surety business in this State in the same amount as the net worth for the applicant's license group with his initial or renewal application.

qualifier_replacement_notice_days.quote: When a primary qualifying party ceases to serve as a primary qualifying party for a licensee, the licensee or the primary qualifying party shall notify the department in writing within fifteen days of the disassociation.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: If the licensee or primary qualifying party notifies the department within the prescribed time, the license remains in good standing for ninety days from the date the department receives notice of the disassociation.
